title: Cardiovascular conditioning
learning_outcomes: Explain energy systems in the context of cardiovascular conditioning.
Compare and distinguish intensity measures in the context of cardiovascular conditioning.
Apply gradual conditioning in the context of cardiovascular conditioning.
Evaluate and justify decisions about recovery monitoring in the context of cardiovascular conditioning.

lessons.title: Energy systems
lessons.outcome: Explain energy systems in the context of cardiovascular conditioning.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving energy systems; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to conditioning plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain energy systems from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of energy systems; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Intensity measures
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish intensity measures in the context of cardiovascular conditioning.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving intensity measures; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to conditioning plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain intensity measures from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of intensity measures; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Gradual conditioning
lessons.outcome: Apply gradual conditioning in the context of cardiovascular conditioning.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving gradual conditioning; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to conditioning plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain gradual conditioning from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of gradual conditioning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Recovery monitoring
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about recovery monitoring in the context of cardiovascular conditioning.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving recovery monitoring; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to conditioning plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain recovery monitoring from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of recovery monitoring; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of energy systems; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of intensity measures; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of gradual conditioning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of recovery monitoring; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
